fact: Ezulwini Municipality's annual report for 2023/24 states that the Council restored its five office communication lines by voice-over-IP carried over an internet line, installed a new PABX linking its two office buildings, bought virtual conferencing equipment and migrated its business email and office software to Microsoft 365; it names no council system run over the connection and does not say who supplies the line.
title: Annual Report 2023 2024
